label: The handoff directory is not validated as a private path boundary (inferred): nudge.cjs follows a pre-existing handoffs symlink, suppresses mkdir/chmod errors, then still returns a note path; CLI containment trusts the resolved handoffs directory without checking it remains beneath the repository. A symlink can redirect writes and chmod outside the repository, while a failed chmod can leave a writable non-private directory. Fix by canonicalizing the repository, rejecting symlinked managed path components and escapes, verifying owner and mode 0700, returning no path on failure, and adding outside-symlink and chmod-failure tests.
